name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller
description: A virtualised, auto-scrolling conversation viewport - pins to the latest message, preserves position on prepend, tracks the anchor, and a floating scroll-to-end button.

meta.whenToUse: A live chat/AI thread that must auto-scroll, virtualise long histories, and offer a jump-to-latest control.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short, static list that fits without scrolling - use Message inside a plain container or Scroll Area.
